status_semantics: No field named status. This record holds the source-image review of the preregistered class 2 and class 3 union.

method.byte_integrity: All 14 pages retrieved fresh and verified against the published folder SHA1SUM. Zero failures.
method.reading: Each canonical band rendered with two rows of context above and below, across both fields, and read directly from the image.
method.transform: Every established correction converted with the sealed WOW v1 tool 042_wow/scripts/wow2_epoch.py, unmodified, run by the owner. Provenance: astropy 8.0.1 / numpy 2.5.2 ; FK4(equinox=B1950, obstime=B1950) -> FK5(equinox=J2000).

faulty_field_among_the_eight_membership_.note: The RA sensitivity established in class 1 is not a single event. Five of the eight rows that sat inside the sealed window did so because of a right ascension misreading.

H2.statement: Rare stored declination values, fewer than 10 occurrences in the B1 subset, carry elevated transcription and false-B1-membership risk.

H3.statement: Source pages producing 3 or fewer B1 rows carry elevated transcription and false-B1-membership risk.

hypotheses_scored_separately.overlap: 13 rows belong to both classes. The two are scored separately so it is clear which signal carried the result. H2 is the stronger of the two on this material.

selection_boundary.statement: This population was deliberately risk-selected. The classes were defined because low frequency was suspected to indicate error, and the suspicion arose from two artifacts found earlier.
selection_boundary.consequence: No proportion from this review may be described as a general transcription or OCR error rate. Not 58 percent, not 33 percent, not any figure derived from these 24 rows.
selection_boundary.what_it_does_support: Low-frequency features are usable for PRIORITISATION. They can be computed over the whole population without reading a single image.

two_distinct_truth_questions.B1_MEMBERSHIP_CORRECT: Does the row belong inside the sealed window?
two_distinct_truth_questions.COORDINATE_CORRECT: Is the stored coordinate the value printed on the page?
two_distinct_truth_questions.why_they_must_be_kept_apart: The six non-membership-changing errors are rows that belong in the region but carry a wrong coordinate. A frozen manifest that only asserts membership would carry six known-wrong coordinates without saying so.
two_distinct_truth_questions.all_six: Each was a declination misread by a few arcminutes: -26 48 read as -26 49 twice, -26 46 as -26 49 and as -26 46 variants, -26 38 as -26 48, -26 37 as -26 47, -27 21 as -27 21 with an RA error. In every case the corrected value still falls inside the window.

rows.note: The page carries a printed annotation line reading 0443,DC-2714,LAT 26.3,LN which independently confirms the declination. The declination was correct; the right ascension was misread.

ESTABLISHED: Low-frequency features are empirically associated with elevated transcription risk within the preregistered reviewed classes.
Right ascension misreadings cause false B1 membership repeatedly, not once: 5 of the 8 membership-changing errors were RA.
Transcription errors occur that do NOT change membership: 6 rows belong in the region while carrying a wrong coordinate.
NOT_ESTABLISHED: The magnitude of that association in the remaining B1 population.
Completeness of B1, because 138 of 918 pages remain RA_COLUMN_UNRESOLVED.

next_step_required: A preregistered random sample drawn from the approximately 11690 unreviewed rows. Only such a sample can give the base rate that these deliberately risk-selected classes cannot.
class_1_not_folded_in: The two class-1 rows, 013-063 and 013-193, are excluded from every count above. They generated the hypotheses and are recorded in B1_CLASS1_VERIFICATION_v1.json.
